// DELIVERABLE: ui-migrate / Styles + Typography + dark Home group (7 routes).
// Contract: opurom-spec/FLUTTER_GALLERY_SINGLE_APP.md. Pure text, not compiled here.
// All content copied from device-verified apps/gallery_* sources; new rows use
// golden-measured fontPx and opurom-icons official names. No baked text.
//
// GLOBAL STATE DECLARATIONS (add once to the app root state list):
//   state tabRed = true
//   state tabPink = false
//   state tabPurple = false
//   state tabDeep = false
//   state styleRows = ["Motion", "Colors", "Typography", "2D transformations"]
//   state styleSubs = ["All of the predefined transition patterns", "All of the predefined colors", "All of the predefined text styles", "Pan, zoom, rotate"]
//   state styleIcons = ["transition-right", "color-picker", "text-caption", "grid-3x3"]
//   state bodyRoles = ["Headline 2", "Headline 3", "Headline 4", "Headline 5", "Headline 6", "Subtitle 1", "Subtitle 2", "Body Text 1", "Body Text 2", "Button", "Caption", "Overline"]
//   state bodySamples = ["Light 60sp", "Regular 48sp", "Regular 34sp", "Regular 24sp", "Medium 20sp", "Regular 16sp", "Medium 14sp", "Regular 16sp", "Regular 14sp", "MEDIUM (ALL CAPS) 14sp", "Regular 12sp", "REGULAR (ALL CAPS) 10sp"]
//
// ROOT REQUIREMENTS (owned by the main file, do NOT duplicate in these routes):
//   quality { msaa: 4 }
//   theme { ... }   -- dark Home uses the component params below, not scattered hex
//
// NAVIGATION EDGES:
//   StylesList --tap Colors push--> Colors ; --tap Typography push--> Typography
//   StylesList --scroll push--> StylesListScroll1
//   Typography --scroll push--> TypographyBody
//   SettingsThemeOptions (mobile-fix) --Dark push--> HomeDark
//
// ICONS: official opurom-icons names only: transition-right, color-picker,
//   text-caption, grid-3x3, arrow-left, info-circle, code, devices.
//
// KERNEL GAPS (reported, not fabricated):
//   - Runtime For binds item only to Text interpolation; Icon(name:) is not
//     interpolated at layout, so list icons use compile-time `for (i in N)`
//     with `{icons[i]}` (substituted to a literal name before compile).
//   - No per-route theme selector: dark Home carries its palette once as
//     component params, so colour is centralized, not scattered in the tree.

  // Dark palette centralized as token-named params; values sampled from
  // golden gallery-dark.png flat regions (md-sys-color-* dark values).
  component DarkHome(stage: string, hero: string, card: string, ink: string, label: string, muted: string, rose: string) {
      Container(width: 1080, height: 2200, color: "{stage}", border: "{stage}", p: 0) {
        Column(p: 0, gap: 0, align: start, color: "{stage}", border: "{stage}") {
          Spacer(height: 66)
          Container(width: 1080, height: 70, color: "{stage}", border: "{stage}", p: 0) {
            Row(p: 0, gap: 0, align: start, color: "{stage}", border: "{stage}") {
              Spacer(width: 84)
              Text("Gallery", size: 56, fontPx: 45, weight: "bold", color: "{label}", label: "gallery/title")
            }
          }
          Spacer(height: 38)
          Container(width: 1080, height: 524, color: "{stage}", border: "{stage}", p: 0) {
            Row(p: 0, gap: 0, align: start, color: "{stage}", border: "{stage}") {
              Spacer(width: 84)
              Container(width: 912, height: 524, color: "{hero}", border: "{hero}", rounded: 26, p: 0) {
                Column(p: 0, gap: 0, align: start, color: "{hero}", border: "{hero}") {
                  Container(width: 912, height: 180, color: "{hero}", border: "{hero}", p: 0) {
                    Row(p: 0, gap: 0, align: start, color: "{hero}", border: "{hero}") {
                      Spacer(width: 45)
                      Image(src: "data:image/png;base64,", width: 220, height: 180, border: "{hero}", label: "hero/gold_shape")
                      Spacer(width: 289)
                      Image(src: "data:image/png;base64,", width: 358, height: 180, border: "{hero}", label: "hero/right_0")
                    }
